We present the first WISDOM study of a luminous infrared galaxy with an active galactic nuclei (AGN): Fairall 49. We use new ALMA observations of the CO($2-1$) line with a spatial resolution of $\sim$80 pc together with ancillary HST imaging.
This work highlights the potential of using high-resolution CO data to estimate, in addition to SMBH masses, the X$_{\rm CO}$ factor and gas inflow rates in nearby galaxies.
